jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Greenboard

At Greenboard, we’re building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money.

Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We’re backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard — and we’re growing fast.

About the role:

As a member of the engineering team, you’ll get the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems from building AI agents to detect insider trading to scaling message archiving systems to handle tens of millions of messages per day. You’ll also have the opportunity to work with a group of world-class engineers.

This is a full-time on-site role as a Full-Stack Software Engineer at Greenboard, located in NYC.

Who Are You?

  • Love to move fast and build things

  • Looking for deep ownership over the products you build

  • Obsess over the customers you’re building for

  • An excellent communicator

  • Value collaboration

  • Located in NYC

Qualifications

  • 3-5 Years of Industry Experience

  • Strong programming skills in Node JS and Python

  • Experience with architecting secure, scalable systems in AWS

  • Experience with developing scalable data infrastructure

  • Knowledge of AI and machine learning algorithms

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience in the financial industry is a plus, but not necessary

Benefits

  • 401(k) with 5% company match

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 15 days PTO + 11 company holidays + flexible sick time

  • 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days)

  • 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays

  • Bi-annual off-sites and team retreats

  • Front-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Greenboard

At Greenboard, we’re building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money.

Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We’re backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard — and we’re growing fast.

About the role:

As Director of Engineering, you’ll lead both technical execution and engineering culture. This is a hands-on role, especially in the early months — you’ll be deep in the codebase, owning systems end-to-end, and setting the bar for quality, speed, and reliability as we scale.

This is a full-time, on-site role located in NYC.

What You’ll Work On

  • Lead and scale Greenboard’s engineering function

  • Write, review, and ship production code (especially early on)

  • Own system reliability, uptime, and incident response

  • Make architectural decisions that balance speed and durability

  • Build and scale secure, high-volume systems for regulated financial data

  • Partner closely with product and leadership on execution and prioritization

  • Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team

  • Establish a culture of accountability and extreme ownership

Who Are You?

  • A proven senior engineer who still loves being hands-on

  • Comfortable getting into the weeds when systems break

  • Obsessed with ownership — you don’t let problems linger

  • Able to move fast in ambiguous, early-stage environments

  • A strong communicator who values in-person collaboration

  • Located in (or willing to relocate to) NYC

Qualifications

Required

  • Significant experience as a senior engineer (Staff / Principal / Senior IC background)

  • Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience

  • Experience architecting and operating production systems

  • Experience owning on-call and production reliability

  • Willingness to be hands-on in an on-site startup environment

Preferred

  • Startup experience (Series A–Series B) or previous founder

  • Experience building or scaling early engineering teams

  • AWS or similar cloud infrastructure experience

  • Experience working with regulated or data-intensive systems

Benefits

  • 401(k) with 5% company match

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 15 days PTO + 11 company holidays + flexible sick time

  • 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days)

  • 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays

  • Bi-annual off-sites and team retreats

  • Front-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance

jobs.title: Operations and Strategy Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Greenboard

At Greenboard, we’re building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money.

Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We’re backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard — and we’re growing fast.

About the Role:

As an Operations & Strategy Associate, you’ll work directly with the Head of Operations & Strategy to scale how Greenboard operates. You’ll own foundational RevOps and finance operations, develop reporting that leadership trusts, and drive high-impact cross-functional projects to completion. You’ll research and implement the systems and processes that power our go-to-market and back office, and create high-quality financial and operational models to inform prioritization and resourcing decisions.

This is a full-time, on-site role in NYC.

What You’ll Work On

  • Manage RevOps fundamentals, including maintaining CRM hygiene and building pipeline + conversion reporting the team trusts

  • Research and evaluate RevOps and finance systems (CRM, billing/invoicing, expense management, reporting/BI, data tooling); develop recommendations with clear tradeoffs and implementation plans

  • Own and maintain detailed financial, operational, and pricing models, ensuring the highest quality and accuracy to inform prioritization and resourcing decisions

  • Support Head of Operations & Strategy with day-to-day finance operations, including invoicing and collections (AR), vendor payments (AP), expense management, and keeping records clean and up to date

  • Create lightweight dashboards and decision materials (briefs, KPIs, reporting) that synthesize quantitative + qualitative inputs and surface trends, risks, and operational insights for leadership

  • Run focused competitive/market analyses (e.g., pricing, positioning, tooling landscape) tied to specific decisions

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to unblock execution and resolve issues quickly

Who Are You?

  • A high-ownership operator who loves turning ambiguity into plans, owners, and measurable outcomes

  • Structured and analytical, you can work with data, define metrics, and explain what the numbers mean

  • Comfortable juggling multiple workstreams and driving alignment without formal authority

  • Resourceful and action-oriented in early-stage environments; you start from zero and iterate quickly

  • You like formulating the first version of a process, running it, and iterating fast based on what breaks

Qualifications

Required

  • 1-4 years of experience in consulting/investment banking and/or operating roles at a high-growth startup (BizOps, Strategy & Ops, RevOps, or Finance)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

  • Ruthless prioritization with a strong bias to action

  • Extreme attention to detail with a high regard for precision

  • Strong organizational and project management skills; able to manage multiple workstreams and drive clarity from ambiguity

  • Proactive problem-solver who turns strategy into plans with owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes

  • Hustle, resourcefulness, and ownership suited to an early-stage startup

  • Excellent relationship-builder with ability to influence without authority

  • Demonstrated ability to design a simple process, implement it, measure it, and iterate

Preferred

  • Familiarity with creating and enhancing operating cadences (OKRs/KPIs, reporting, cross-functional planning)

  • Exposure to fintech, compliance, or financial operations products

  • Comfort operating with limited structure in early-stage environments

  • Proficiency in spreadsheet-based financial/operating models (budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning)

  • Experience with HubSpot

Benefits

  • Salary range: $100,000–$140,000 + meaningful equity

  • 401(k) with 5% company match

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 15 days PTO + 11 company holidays + flexible sick time

  • 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days)

  • 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays

  • Bi-annual off-sites and team retreats

  • Front-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance
